items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: I remember Joe... he said to me, he said, goodbye old boy, I'll never forget that.

ctx.x: Did you say he left here with somebody?
I think he left here with Joe, with Joe Oliver.
Yeah he was with him in Chicago for a while, I know he played with him up there. I don't know if he was…

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: I know, I know, I know probably all the musicians, man. ... Orin, Oliver and all that bunch when they left.

ctx.x: Well he's eight years younger than George. He wouldn't be around now. I guess by the time he got to going, Jimbo had left town.

Well I guess that's about it. Yeah, that's about it. Because I don't remember him. I know, I know, I know probably all the musicians, man. But I was down through here and most anywhere around in two, three hundred miles. A little more. All the men when they left. Jimbo, Jimmy Collar, all them big men. Orin, Oliver and all that bunch when they left. Lewis.
When did Jimbo leave? Do you remember about what year it was?
